mood: Cosy and silly: a pastel laundry room where smiling garments tumble into baskets.

shape.texture: soft white checker tiles at 35% opacity

buttonStyle: Primary is a sky-blue pill with white Lilita One text and a thick navy outline, bouncing 4px up on hover; secondary is a white pill with a navy outline and a yellow hover fill.
backdrop: Pastel blue checker wall with a washing machine in the middle whose round window slowly swirls (rotate transform) and a few bubbles floating upward.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
